name: Small Business
description: Starter pack for small business owners without staff: finances, tax obligations, marketing and operations in one calendar.

definitions.title: Daily sales log entry
definitions.note: Record the day's sales and receipts in the accounting system.

definitions.title: Daily cash reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile the till or cash box against sales.

definitions.title: Weekly social media posting
definitions.note: Schedule the week's social media posts.

definitions.title: Weekly supplier payment run
definitions.note: Pay suppliers due this week and log the payments.

definitions.title: Monthly inventory count
definitions.note: Count stock and update reorder points.

definitions.title: Monthly bookkeeping close
definitions.note: Close the previous month and reconcile accounts.

definitions.title: Monthly sales tax filing prep
definitions.note: Prepare sales tax figures for the filing period.

definitions.title: Quarterly tax instalment payment
definitions.note: Pay the quarterly tax instalment on time.

definitions.title: Business license renewal
definitions.note: Renew the business license before year end.

definitions.title: Insurance review
definitions.note: Review liability and property insurance before renewal.

definitions.title: Business plan refresh
definitions.note: Refresh the yearly plan, targets and budget.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc customer issue
definitions.note: Resolve a customer complaint or issue - set the due date when creating it.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc purchase decision
definitions.note: Research and decide a significant purchase.
